End-to-end integration testing for distributed .NET systems, authored in declarative .e2e.yaml. vouchfx compiles YAML to memory-safe C# via Roslyn, orchestrates the required container topology with .NET Aspire + Testcontainers, and verifies one business transaction across HTTP (REST/SOAP), databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, DynamoDB), message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, Azure Service Bus, Redis Streams), cache/search (Redis, Elasticsearch), S3 object storage, Prometheus metrics, OTLP distributed traces, SMTP capture, webhooks and inline C# — twenty-five providers across eleven step families, with engine-owned RETRY polling, execution-time secret resolution with at-source redaction, and a four-verdict taxonomy where only Fail breaks CI by default.
